title: Sales by Category totals equal Sales by Tier's
refs: SV-11718 (Reports Story 5 S5-R1 S5-R3 S5-R2 S5-E2)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access', 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new category for this test, category B, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix B, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 50.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Make sure tier A's column in matrix B is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, with a part in category A, cost $100.00, priced $121.50 by tier A and a part in category B, cost $100.00, priced $135.00 by tier A, invoiced today.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
  3. Open category B's row.
  4. Open Reports › Sales by Tier.
  5. Pick customer A in the Customer filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • The columns read Category, Parts Cost, Parts Invoiced, Parts Credits, Parts Net, Parts Margin, Parts Margin % and % of Total.
  • Category A reads $121.50, category B $135.00; Totals $256.50 ($121.50 + $135.00).
  • Category A reads 47.37% ($121.50 ÷ $256.50) and category B 52.63% ($135.00 ÷ $256.50).

Step 3:

  • Category B opens to tier A's row, $135.00, 52.63%: the same share as its parent.

Step 4:

  • Sales by Tier opens.

Step 5:

  • Sales by Tier's Totals read $256.50: $256.50 − $256.50 = $0.00.
